author: Learn Linux TV
description:
The Linux community is awesome, but Linux has its quirks and annoyances too. In this video, I rant a little about five Linux pet peeves, from tutorials that auto-confirm commands with “-y” and messy source installations, to elitism and the myth that Linux requires the terminal. Think of it as constructive criticism from someone who wants to see Linux succeed.

What are your Linux pet peeves? Let me know in the comments!
